response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, st.healtheval AS healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.healtheval AS health_status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY excess_over_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Scan count is the number of all scans in the group (COUNT(*)), including scans with missing gbsize or spanmin; only the ratio average ignores them.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing ratio (NULLIF) to avoid division errors.
The mean of group averages is an unweighted mean across groups, ignoring groups whose average is NULL.
